sheet: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ART-PET-001 concept_sheet.png for Asterveil Fateweave. Exact canvas 2048x1152. Reference images supplied are style references: units.webp heroic chibi crisp dark outlines, painted cel shading, jewel tones; tileset/decor luminous painted fantasy world. Six ORIGINAL tiny companion creatures, cute heroic-chibi, not heroes, no known franchise resemblance. Uniform visual scale, two rows three columns, pale warm neutral background. Each cell: one large full-body front three-quarter view facing RIGHT, and beneath it two truly tiny SOLID DARK silhouette tests at exactly 32 pixel tall and 64 pixel tall. Absolutely NO TEXT, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, UI, ground shadows or rings. Row1 left: dandelion-fluff FOX KIT, cream head ruff, ochre short legs, big seed-puff tail, leaf green inner ears, broad triangular ears and long muzzle; center: MOSS-BACKED PIGLET, stout low bean body, terracotta snout, dark teal moss saddle with just two broad leaves, stubby feet, curled tail; right: CRYSTAL MOTH, ivory furry thorax, four broad angular lilac translucent crystal wings arranged as trapezoid top pair and small bottom pair, dark plum veins, two short bent antennae, tiny eyes, no humanoid face. Row2 left: GARGOYLE PUP, slate gray squat stone canine with blunt ears, two small folded buttress wings, champagne stone chest plate, chunky feet, no devil horns; center: LANTERN OWL, upright pear silhouette, dark teal feather hood, cream heart facial disc, amber chest light enclosed by feather ribs like lantern, short broad wings, no carried accessory; right: STAR-VEIL SLIME, low asymmetric rounded translucent navy-lilac body, one sweeping crescent veil crest folded over back, internal mint oval healing seed, two simple eyes, no star symbols. Match rendering finish across six; broad simple shapes and readable anatomy. Render all six same pet scale, about half Knight height when in game. Concepts only, not sprite animation.
